description: This file defines a utility class 'UiUtils' providing static methods for UI-related operations such as setting activity titles and configuring clickable links within TextViews in an Android application.

classes.name: UiUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for UI operations in an Android app, such as setting activity titles and configuring clickable links within TextViews.

methods.name: setActivityTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the activity hosting the given fragment, if the fragment is hosted by the activity's fragment manager.

methods.name: setActivityTitle
methods.description: Overloaded method that sets the activity title using a string resource ID.

methods.name: setupLink
methods.description: Configures a TextView within a view hierarchy to display a clickable span, optionally reordering the link within its parent ViewGroup.
